SECTION B: (2 Marks Each)

Q25. Find the value of k for which the system of linear equations has infinitely many solutions:
kx + 3y = k − 3
12x + ky = k

Answer / Solution:
For infinitely many solutions:
a1/a2 = b1/b2 = c1/c2
k/12 = 3/k = (k-3)/k
From k/12 = 3/k => k^2 = 36 => k = ±6
Check k = 6:
3/6 = (6-3)/6 => 1/2 = 1/2 (true)
Check k = -6:
3/(-6) ≠ (-6-3)/(-6) (false)
Answer: k = 6
